title: Red Chain Whip Warrior
description: A female character with long black and red hair, wearing a red and black outfit with corset and boots, is shown in multiple dynamic action poses. She wields a spiked metal chain whip that glows with red energy and sparks, with one large detailed close-up of the whip's tail at the top.
prompt: A fierce young woman with long flowing black hair streaked with red, wearing a revealing red and black corset top, short skirt, and heavy boots, dynamically posed in multiple action stances. She attacks with a long spiked metal chain whip that emits bright red glowing energy and white sparks. Multiple views showing running, striking, and power-up poses against a plain gray background, dark fantasy character design, detailed digital illustration.
